quotes.file: Tengyur/03 SHES PHYIN_Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñā Pāramitā)/VOL 1 (KA)/TD03786_SHES RAB KYI PHA ROL TU PHYIN PA'I MAN NGAG GI BSTAN BCOS MNGON PAR RTOGS PA'I RGYAN ZHES BYA BA'I TSIG LE'UR BYAS PA (Abhisamayālaṃkāra Nāma Prajñā Pāramita Upadeśa Śāstra Kārikā)_unicode.txt
quotes.why: Maitreya's root verse listing the ten instructions; the paragraph's lemmas མཐོང་ལམ་དང་། and སྒོམ་ཞེས་བྱ་ལ། are the last two items of this line. Located by direct search of the Tengyur.

quotes.file: Tengyur/03 SHES PHYIN_Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñā Pāramitā)/VOL 7 (JA)/TD03793_SHES RAB KYI PHA ROL TU PHYIN PA'I MAN NGAG GI BSTAN BCOS MNGON PAR RTOGS PA'I RGYAN ZHES BYA BA'I 'GREL PA (Abhisamayālaṃkāra Nāma Prajñā Pāramita Upadeśa Śāstra Vṛtti)_unicode.txt
quotes.why: Haribhadra's own gloss, which the paragraph quotes verbatim; note that it reads ལུས་ཅན་དེས (instrumental) where the yig cha has ལུས་ཅན་དེ, and that it names no class of abandonables.

quotes.file: Tengyur/03 SHES PHYIN_Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñā Pāramitā)/VOL 3 (GA)/TD03790-1_SHES RAB KYI PHA ROL TU PHYIN PA STONG PHRAG NYI SHU LNGA PA (Pañca Viṃśatisāhasrikā Prajñā Pāramitā)_unicode.txt
quotes.citation: ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པ་སྟོང་ཕྲག་ཉི་ཤུ་ལྔ་པ། (ལེའུ་བརྒྱད་མ།) — Haribhadra's rearranged 25,000, Tengyur, Derge 3790, at the close of the sixteen moments
quotes.why: The sūtra line the paragraph quotes, in the form it quotes it (with རབ་འབྱོར་ and སུ), immediately after Haribhadra's own label closing the seeing-path section — the source of the paragraph's starting boundary.

quotes.file: Tengyur/03 SHES PHYIN_Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñā Pāramitā)/VOL 3 (GA)/TD03790-1_SHES RAB KYI PHA ROL TU PHYIN PA STONG PHRAG NYI SHU LNGA PA (Pañca Viṃśatisāhasrikā Prajñā Pāramitā)_unicode.txt
quotes.citation: ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པ་སྟོང་ཕྲག་ཉི་ཤུ་ལྔ་པ། (ལེའུ་བརྒྱད་མ།) — Tengyur, Derge 3790, end of the ten instructions
quotes.why: Haribhadra's label that fixes the paragraph's closing boundary: the meditation-path instruction ends at ཆོས་ལ་སྲེད་པའོ, and with it the whole section on instructions.

quotes.file: Kangyur/3. NYI KHRI (Perfection of Wisdom in 25,000 Lines (Pañca Viṃśati Sāhasrikā Prajñā Pāramitā)/VOL 1 (KA)/KL00009E1INC_SHES RAB KYI PHA ROL TU PHYIN PA STONG PHRAG NYI SHU LNGA PA 1_The Perfection of Wisdom in 25,000 Lines, Part 1 (Pañca Viṃśati Sāhasrikā Prajñā Pāramitā 1)_unicode.txt
quotes.why: The same line in the Kangyur's unrearranged 25,000, where it is introduced by དེ་ཅིའི་ཕྱིར་ཞེ་ན as the reason for the sentence before it, not as the opening of a new instruction. Found by direct search.

quotes.file: Tengyur/03 SHES PHYIN_Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñā Pāramitā)/VOL 1 (KA)/TD03787_'PHAGS PA SHES RAB KYI PHA ROL TU PHYIN PA STONG PHRAG NYI SHU LNGA PA'I MAN NGAG GI BSTAN BCOS MNGON PAR RTOGS PA'I RGYAN GYI 'GREL PA (Ārya Pañca Viṃśatisāhasrikā Prajñā Pāramita Upadeśa Śāstrābhisamayālam_unicode.txt
quotes.why: Ārya Vimuktisena, the earliest commentator, already reads this sūtra line as the meditation-path instruction and says what it means: conditioned = path, unconditioned = abandonment.
Gyaltsab Je's syllogism, which the paragraph's own ཆོས་ཅན sentence reproduces almost word for word — including the specification ཀུན་བརྟགས that Haribhadra does not make.
Gyaltsab Je on the same sūtra line: it teaches the meditation path 'by way of an example' (དཔེའི་སྒོ་ནས), as antidote to the innate (ལྷན་སྐྱེས) abandonables.
Tsongkhapa glosses Haribhadra's 'what is to be abandoned by it' as མཐོང་སྤང — by path, not by the imputed/innate distinction that Gyaltsab Je and this yig cha use.

Tsongkhapa's second ('or else') reading, which explains why a sūtra sentence about the conditioned and unconditioned elements counts as an instruction on the meditation path at all: it is the example, and Haribhadra's gloss applies it.
Chökyi Gyaltsen, opening the next topic, picks up the sūtra exactly where this paragraph leaves it — at ཆོས་ལ་སྲེད་པའོ — confirming the boundary from the other side.
The Loseling textbook divides these two instructions by imputed and innate abandonables exactly as Gyaltsab Je does, so on this point Sera Jey and Drepung Loseling do not differ.
